T-021.reason: MAJOR FIX-DOC, independently verified from committed raw data: data/raw/stage4-run2/events.jsonl 14:40:31Z warning fit_changed_explicit_placement on tuned-64K (fit_succeeded false, fit_intervened true, required_reduction_mib 18, offloaded_layers [42,42], tensor_overrides_to_cpu true) — the session's only warning; every other session has exactly one code_commit_changed. startup_excerpt: projected 14766 MiB vs 15772 MiB free (stage3-64K and stage4: 15803), 1024 MiB target missed by 18 MiB, 'context size set by user to 65536 -> no change', 'tensor_buft_overrides already set by user, abort'. argv, resolved config, props and measured VRAM byte/value-identical to run 1 (loaded 14934, after_warmup_used 15280, peak 15292, min_free 1019). Fix: add the warning, comparison table, startup lines, identity check and driver-confound link to docs/stage4-run2-conditions.md; name it in the T-008 handoff. No re-measure, no re-analysis of measurements.

MAJOR DECIDE: the scope of R7's 'while a server is generating' is a rule interpretation the card's decision_rights.must_escalate reserves to the planning chat ('any stop rule firing, including R7'); the executor resolved the poll-3 ambiguity inline without an escalation brief. Reviewer's re-derivation, independently reproduced by me from committed telemetry: 3,556 sustained-generation samples (P1, >=50 W, >=2500 MHz) and all 2,657 measured-cell samples Gen4 x8; exactly two util>0 non-Gen4 rows session-wide, both idle-to-load ramps in re-run canaries (15:01:21.726Z util 94% gen 2 P5 9.92 W; 15:07:42.999Z util 26% gen 2 P5 9.77 W), link back at Gen4 within one 0.5 s sample. Escalating with option A (ratify under-load reading; reviewer recommendation) and option B (strict reading); reviewer orders no RE-MEASURE. A5's link clause stays ESCALATE until the ruling; R6 makes the interpretation consequential.
